name: c-energie
description: c-energie's Claude Code / Cowork tooling: the context-repo system and the plugins built on it.
_comment: A field in a plugins[] entry OVERRIDES the same field in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
Declare name / description / version ONLY in plugin.json. Keep this file to the
marketplace-specific fields: source, category, tags, strict.
The catalog `name` is what an identifier reads as: context-kit-core@c-energie. It is
deliberately the ORG, not the repo — one catalog per GitHub org, holding every plugin
that org's people share. A separate org gets a separate catalog (net-flex/claude-tools);
same people plus a new topic gets a new plugin in this one. See README.md.
version 1.0.0 is the marker that the pre-rename identifiers are dead: this catalog was
named `context-kit` at 0.1.0, in a repo of that name, until 2026-08-31. An enabledPlugins
entry reading X@context-kit is stale and enables nothing.
